comment: Single source of pass/fail for the microphone self-test (console 60 VESPER_TEST_AUDIO) on KOL, Vesper and Pipistrelle. Read by VesperApp (embedded); factory-sw should read the same file. Firmware reports measurements only (audio_selftest.h). Every threshold below is a first estimate: validated = false until the bench procedure (docs/audio-selftest.md in Kol / VesperU5) has run on real units.

stimulus.description: 1 kHz and 4 kHz together, steady, from a phone or small speaker about 10 cm from the microphone(s); about 70-80 dB SPL at the microphone (a phone at full volume at 10 cm).
stimulus.to_validate: the level a typical phone gives at 10 cm; whether a tap test is a usable fallback when no tone source is at hand

pass.to_validate: level_min_dbfs against a quiet room with the stimulus off (should fail the tones but stay above the stuck/dead floor); dc_max_counts on several units (high-pass is off during the test); max_channel_spread_db on KOL with the stimulus centred
